scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check scripts shell src tests package.json vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .knip.jsonc quality docs/code-quality.md '!scripts/fixtures/**/*.json'
scripts.test:rust: node scripts/check-shell-parser.mjs && cargo fmt --manifest-path shell/Cargo.toml --all --check && cargo test --locked --manifest-path shell/Cargo.toml --workspace -j2
scripts.test:shell:scoreboard: npm run build:node-harness && npm run test:shell:scoreboard:prebuilt
scripts.compat:shell: npm run build:node-harness && npm run compat:shell:prebuilt
scripts.build:browser: npm run sources:browser && npm run build:worker && npm run build:shell:browser && npm run build:test-guest && npm run build:browser:assets
scripts.verify:browser: npm run test:browser:package && npm run build:browser && npm run typecheck:browser && npm run test:runtime:terminal && npm run test:browser
scripts.typecheck:layers: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --target ESNext --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node --allowImportingTsExtensions scripts/check-layers.ts scripts/test-check-layers.ts
scripts.lint: oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --deny-warnings src scripts tests vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.quality: npm run sources:browser && npm run build:worker && npm run quality:js && npm run check:rust && cargo test --locked --manifest-path shell/Cargo.toml --workspace -j2 --no-fail-fast
scripts.test:guest-build: node --test scripts/test-wasi-build.ts scripts/test-waffle-release-inputs.ts scripts/test-verify-wasi-guests.ts scripts/test-build-compat-control.ts scripts/test-wasi-guest-path.ts scripts/test-waffle-fixture-lifecycle.ts
scripts.typecheck:guest-build: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --target ESNext --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node --allowImportingTsExtensions scripts/check-shell-capabilities.ts scripts/wasi-build.ts scripts/waffle-release-inputs.ts scripts/build-compat-control.ts scripts/test-build-compat-control.ts scripts/test-shell-wasi.ts scripts/wasi-build.ts scripts/verify-wasi-guests.ts scripts/test-verify-wasi-guests.ts scripts/wasi-guest-path.ts scripts/test-wasi-guest-path.ts scripts/waffle-fixture-lifecycle.ts scripts/test-waffle-fixture-lifecycle.ts
scripts.quality:js: npm run test:browser:package && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:unused && npm run check:duplicates && npm run test:quality-gates
scripts.build:browser:assets: npm run notices:browser && npm run bundle:browser:assets
scripts.test:ci: node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/test-ci-inputs.ts scripts/test-ci-workflow.ts scripts/test-prepare-wasi-tests.ts scripts/test-ci-artifacts.ts scripts/test-ci-notices.ts scripts/test-scoreboard-discovery.mjs
scripts.typecheck:ci: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --target ESNext --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node --allowImportingTsExtensions scripts/ci-inputs.ts scripts/ci-artifacts.ts scripts/prepare-wasi-tests.ts scripts/test-ci*.ts scripts/test-prepare-wasi-tests.ts
scripts.build:browser:assets:ci: npm run notices:browser:ci && npm run bundle:browser:assets
scripts.test:shell:completion:pending: npm run build:node-harness && BASH_COMPLETION_PENDING=1 node --test scripts/test-own-shell-completion.ts
scripts.test:shell:function-names:pending: npm run build:node-harness && BASH_FUNCTION_NAMES_PENDING=1 node --test scripts/test-own-shell-function-names.ts
